proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ s A B H hA hB hAB hH
  refine ⟨fun h => by rw [dist_comm]; exact EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.dist_center_lt_radius_of_sbtw hA hB h, fun h => ?_⟩
  have hcol : Collinear ℝ ({A, H, B} : Set P) := by
    have := collinear_insert_of_mem_affineSpan_pair hH
    convert this using 1
    ext x; simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; tauto
  exact EuclideanGeometry.sbtw_of_collinear_of_dist_center_lt_radius hcol hA h hB hAB
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B H : P), A ∈ s → B ∈ s → A ≠ B → H ∈ line[ℝ, A, B] → (Sbtw ℝ A H B ↔ dist H s.center < s.radius)
